content:
We need to correctly format tool call. The tool search_template_catalog_by_criteria requires at least molecule_smiles. We can provide only molecule_smiles and limit. Let's do that.

<thought>Search for any templates applicable to the target molecule without functional group filters.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CO)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
